# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Geometry helpers
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def cross(ax, ay, bx, by):
    return ax * by - ay * bx

def dot(ax, ay, bx, by):
    return ax * bx + ay * by

def point_on_segment(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by):
    # check if point p is on segment ab (including endpoints)
    if cross(bx - ax, by - ay, px - ax, py - ay) != 0:
        return False
    return min(ax, bx) <= px <= max(ax, bx) and min(ay, by) <= py <= max(ay, by)

def segments_intersect(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, dx, dy):
    # returns True if segments AB and CD intersect (including at endpoints)
    d1 = cross(bx - ax, by - ay, cx - ax, cy - ay)
    d2 = cross(bx - ax, by - ay, dx - ax, dy - ay)
    d3 = cross(dx - cx, dy - cy, ax - cx, ay - cy)
    d4 = cross(dx - cx, dy - cy, bx - cx, by - cy)
    if ((d1 > 0 and d2 < 0) or (d1 < 0 and d2 > 0)) and \
       ((d3 > 0 and d4 < 0) or (d3 < 0 and d4 > 0)):
        return True
    # collinear cases
    if d1 == 0 and point_on_segment(cx, cy, ax, ay, bx, by):
        return True
    if d2 == 0 and point_on_segment(dx, dy, ax, ay, bx, by):
        return True
    if d3 == 0 and point_on_segment(ax, ay, cx, cy, dx, dy):
        return True
    if d4 == 0 and point_on_segment(bx, by, cx, cy, dx, dy):
        return True
    return False
